version: MIMIC retrospective cohort selection sensitivity v1
scope: R3 selection and interpretation sensitivity, not incident-event prediction or complete leakage exclusion
source_universe: Authenticated original ever-cancer and broad-cardiac source admissions before hospital-death exclusion

arm_rules.ever_survivor: ever_all and original hospital-expire flag equals zero
arm_rules.prior_all: ever_all and both original qualifying diagnosis families in valid source stays completed strictly before current ADMITTIME
arm_rules.prior_survivor: prior_all and original hospital-expire flag equals zero

prior_history_rule: Prior ADMITTIME/DISCHTIME nonmissing, DISCHTIME >= ADMITTIME and DISCHTIME < current ADMITTIME; both qualifying families can occur in different prior stays. Current-discharge validity is audited, not an additional exclusion.
label: Exactly reconstructed original recorded-diagnosis composite, including historical death-plus-broad-cardiac rule; not adjudicated MACE or cause-specific cardiovascular mortality
feature_rule: 41 nominal historical slots with AST and HDL Cholesterol uniformly excluded from the original 43; retain historical unrestricted within-admission aggregation and remaining mapping limitations
outer_rule: Outcome-blind permutation of sorted unique source patients divided into five folds once, shared across all arms
inner_rule: For outer fold f numbered 1..5, independently permute sorted outer-training patients with seed inner_seed_base+f and assign ceil(0.20*N) patients to stopping before applying arm masks
failure_rule: Stop if any arm/role lacks both classes or has no patients; no seed search, arm dropping or outcome-driven redesign
preprocessing: Fit nonempty-column selection and median imputation on inner-fitting only for stopping; refit on eligible outer-training only for final models
primary_model: 50:50 arithmetic mean of XGBoost and random forest; independently trained in each arm/fold
model_seed: Outer fold number 1..5 identically across arms
class_weights: XGBoost negative/positive ratio in current fitting partition; random forest balanced in eligible outer-training partition
calibration: None; report raw ensemble probabilities only
prediction_rule: Each arm-trained model predicts every global outer-test admission; own-arm metrics use only that arm, common-target comparisons use exact prespecified held-out rows
contrast_direction: first minus second; not a causal effect or an estimate of leakage magnitude
bootstrap_seed_rule: Seed base plus target index in the fixed arms list
bootstrap_rule: Exactly 2000 patient-cluster multinomial draws per target, retaining every admission with patient multiplicity; same weights for all compared models on that target
degenerate_rule: Mark draws without both labels invalid and report counts; no replacement draws or new seed; if fewer than 1900 valid draws, do not report a percentile interval
uncertainty: Percentile95% intervals conditional on fixed OOF predictions; no refitting, training-size or clinical-ascertainment uncertainty
multiplicity: Four prespecified exploratory contrasts; no confirmatory multiplicity-controlled claims
limitations: Prior completed diagnosis documentation is not an event-free risk set or authenticated onset time
Full-admission laboratory summaries can reflect concurrent disease and treatment; first result availability remains unknown
Original death rule does not authenticate cardiovascular cause of death
Current invalid admission bounds are reported rather than silently removed
Common-target contrasts change training size, prevalence and case mix as well as selection rules
Remaining assay mappings and clinical negative-label capture are not certified
No clinical adjudication will be performed in this revision because clinical reviewers are unavailable
New results do not replace original AUCs or close all R1/R3 requirements
private_outputs: Admission keys, patient groups, matrices, masks, folds, fitted models and probabilities stay outside manuscript delivery
pre_fit_requirement: Independent preparation verification passed and source/code/environment identities frozen before training
